chunks: And by this chain of narration, from al-Sadiq Jafar b. Muhammad from his father (peace be upon them both) from Jabir b. Abdullah. He said:
Gabriel (peace be upon him) came to the Prophet (may Allah bless him and his family) and ordered him to take oaths with a witness.

key_terms.الشاهد: witness — one who testifies in a legal case
key_terms.اليمين: oath — a sworn statement used alongside witness testimony in judicial proceedings
key_terms.جبرئيل: Gabriel — the archangel who conveyed divine revelation to the Prophet

ai.seo_question: Did Gabriel instruct the Prophet Muhammad to accept oaths with witness testimony in court?
ai.summary: This hadith, continuing the previous chain, reports that the archangel Gabriel himself instructed the Prophet (s) to adopt the legal practice of accepting oaths together with witness testimony. This divine origin elevates the ruling from mere Prophetic custom to a practice commanded by Allah through revelation, strengthening its jurisprudential authority.

en.bilal-muhammad: And by this isnad, from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father (as) from Jabir b. `Abdullah. He said:
Gabriel (as) came to the Prophet (s) and ordered him to take oaths with a witness.
